learning_objective: 🎯 Understand how beautiful things in nature and art provide eternal joy, act as a healing balm for human suffering, and give us a reason to live.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A thing of beauty is a joy forever. Its loveliness keeps increasing, and it never fades into nothingness. It provides a peaceful 'bower' for us to sleep with sweet dreams.
Every morning, we weave a 'flowery band' (our connection to the beautiful things on Earth). This connection keeps us attached to life despite all the struggles.
Human life is filled with sadness, malice, lack of noble people, and gloomy days. But a beautiful thing moves away the 'pall' (dark cloud) from our dark spirits.
Nature is the ultimate source of beauty: the sun, moon, old and young trees, daffodils, clear streams (rills) that cool us in summer, and forests full of musk-roses.

main_concepts.concept_title: 📖 The Beauty of Tales and Legends
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Beauty isn't just physical. The inspiring stories of 'mighty dead' (great heroes) and lovely tales we have read are like an endless fountain of immortal drink pouring down from heaven.

fun_activity.title: 🌼 Your Immortal Drink
fun_activity.instructions: Keats says beautiful things are like an 'immortal drink'. List 3 things in your life (a pet, a favorite song, a beautiful memory) that instantly remove your sadness and act as your 'thing of beauty'.

exam_tips: 📌 This poem is an excerpt from Keats' longer poem 'Endymion'. It heavily focuses on Romanticism and the worship of nature.
📌 Memorize the list of things that cause suffering: 'inhuman dearth of noble natures' (lack of good people), gloomy days, and unhealthy ways.
📌 Poetic devices: Metaphor ('bower quiet', 'immortal drink'), Alliteration ('noble natures', 'cooling covert').
quick_recap: ⭐ The joy provided by a beautiful object is permanent; it never diminishes with time.
⭐ Beautiful things are the only reason we endure the pain and hardships of daily life.
⭐ The 'mighty dead' refers to great martyrs and heroes whose inspiring sacrifices possess immense grandeur and beauty.
